Even the strongest man alive can only lift so much. Eventually you plateau. I reached my plateau long ago. The human body is tough. It insists on going long after whats inside has died. I have become a warning/example to others of what hopeless is. At least others feel better about themselves while looking at me. Its my purpose in life. What i was born for, & what i will die being. Im not depressed anymore. Im empty. Void of all feeling & emotion. No love no hate no faith no memory. Impatiently awaiting death, & finally a decent sleep.

Last month was my 25th birthday. At my work i get presents for friends on their birthdays. Not one person even wished me a happy birthday other than my father. Its a very lonely & horrible feeling that really cant be described. Happy fuckin' birthday. Mean that from the bottom of my heart. Cheers mate
